description: Universal Capability Catalog — CHATR Kernel v0.9 RC. No capability ID may encode an industry. Capabilities are universal runtime primitives. Industry concepts are ontology data, not capability names.

capabilities.purpose: Find possible providers, merchants, resources, records, or options.
Retrieve a known object or state.
Obtain explicit user or policy approval.
Gather structured user or provider fields through schema.
Move value between accounts or stores.
Read external state after or during execution.
Compare observed world state against the goal and choose the next action.
Execute a recovery strategy after partial failure.
Pause a goal until time, event, provider state, or user action.
Reverse or stop a pending action.
Inform the user or another actor.
